description: Add UTM campaign tags to a link: utm_source (required), utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content and utm_id, written in lower case with underscores so analytics tools group them, replacing any UTM tags already on the address. Answers the tagged link, the tags and notes. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

content.description: utm_content: tells two links in one campaign apart.

keepCase.description: Keep capitals and spaces as typed (default: lower case, underscores).

medium.description: utm_medium: the kind of channel (email, social, cpc, referral).

source.description: utm_source: where the visit comes from (newsletter, x, reddit).

url.description: The page the link goes to (https://…).

name: build_utm_link
title: Build a UTM-tagged link
